record.question: Enriched medium is mainly used to:
options: Support the growth of fastidious organisms
Support the growth of all microbes
record.explanation: Answer A: Support the growth of fastidious organisms. Enriched media add extra nutrients (such as blood or serum) to support fastidious organisms. Selective media, by contrast, suppress unwanted organisms. Reference: https://www.atcc.org/resources/culture-guides/bacteriology-culture-guide. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
